items.title: Investing Rs 10 lakh? Experts decode the right mix
items.description: Investors are facing challenges in allocating a lump sum investment due to uncertainty in equity markets. Wealth managers suggest a combination of equities, debt, and gold for varying risk appetites. For conservative investors, a safer asset mix is recommended, while moderate and aggressive strategies differ significantly. Allocation strategies are tailored according to individual investor profiles and market conditions.

items.title: Why L&T Technology shares jumped 11% to hit the Rs 4,000 level afterQ2 results
items.description: L&T Technology Services shares rose sharply past Rs 4,000 after Q2 results beat expectations, driven by margin expansion, AI-led deal wins and strong sustainability business growth. Management expects a stronger second half of FY27, while Motilal Oswal, Nuvama and Nomura raised their target prices but maintained cautious ratings.

items.title: Hindustan Zinc shares jump 4% after Q2 net profit more than doubles. Why Jefferies cut target price?
items.description: Hindustan Zinc reported a 142% year-on-year jump in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 6,412 crore, while revenue rose 77% to Rs 15,093 crore. Despite strong earnings, Jefferies cut its target price to Rs 650 from Rs 750, citing silver price volatility and lower price assumptions for the coming years.

items.title: Anand Rathi Wealth among 5 F&O stocks with a sharp rise in futures open interest
items.description: As of October 19, five stocks in the NSE F&O segment recorded a rise of more than 10% in futures open interest compared with the previous trading session, according to StockEdge F&O scan data. A notable increase in futures open interest indicates a substantial rise in the number of active, unexpired futures contracts in a security. This may reflect market participants initiating new positions or increasing the size of their existing positions.

items.title: Why is market rising today? Sensex jumps 800 points, Nifty above 23,050. 5 key factors behind D-Street rebound
items.description: The Sensex and Nifty rallied nearly 1% as strong Q2 earnings, gains in IT stocks, rupee appreciation and attractive largecap valuations lifted sentiment. However, elevated crude oil prices and rising bond yields remain key risks. Analysts expect market movements to remain stock-specific and driven by corporate earnings.

items.title: Vaibhav Vyapaar Shares to list today; Check GMP ahead of debut
items.description: Vaibhav Vyapaar shares are scheduled to list on the NSE SME platform on October 21, with the IPO commanding a grey market premium of around 6%. The Rs 42.10 crore issue was subscribed 2.27 times. The NBFC plans to use Rs 32 crore from the proceeds to strengthen its capital base.

items.title: UltraTech Cement shares jump 3% as brokerages revise target prices after Q2 results. What Jefferies, Citi are saying
items.description: Shares of UltraTech Cement increased by 3% after the company reported strong quarterly earnings for Q2 FY27. The company's net profit saw a 21% growth compared to the previous year, driven by operational revenue increases. Jefferies raised its target price for the stock, indicating significant upside potential. Meanwhile, Nomura and Citi slightly lowered their estimates due to rising costs and external economic factors.

items.title: Jio IPO beyond telecom: Why the Ambanis are pitching AI, cloud and 7,220 patents as Jio’s tech future
items.description: Jio Platforms ₹30,213 crore IPO marks a significant shift toward technology-driven digital services. With a focus on leveraging its connectivity through AI and cloud technologies, the company is also highlighting its extensive patent holdings. While Reliance Jio Infocomm continues to generate substantial revenue, the company aspires to broaden its reach into enterprise solutions and diverse digital products.

items.title: HD Fire Protect shares list at 24% premium over IPO price on NSE
items.description: HD Fire Protect shares debuted at a premium of up to 23.6% on Wednesday after its Rs 712 crore IPO attracted 131.70 times subscription. The issue was entirely an offer for sale by promoter shareholders. The company reported a 12% rise in FY26 total income to Rs 505 crore.Do you like this personality?

items.title: Himadri Speciality Chemical among 3 stocks to close crossing below VWAP
items.description: On October 19, the closing prices of three stocks from the Nifty 500 pack fell more than 2% below their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Prices), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. VWAP represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, weighted by trading volume. A closing price below VWAP indicates that the stock ended the session below its volume-weighted average traded price.

items.title: Jammu & Kashmir Bank among 3 stocks that closed crossing above VWAP
items.description: On October 19, the closing prices of three stocks in the Nifty 500 pack were more than 1% above their respective VWAPs (Volume Weighted Average Price), according to StockEdge’s technical scan data. When the closing price is above the VWAP, it means the stock closed at a price higher than its volume-weighted average traded price during the day. The VWAP gives greater weight to prices at which higher trading volumes occurred.

items.title: Union Bank Of India among 4 stocks showing RSI trending up
items.description: On October 19, four Nifty500 stocks that gained over 3% were highlighted in the RSI Trending Up scan, based on data from StockEdge. An uptrend signal occurs when the RSI value crosses above 50 from below. “RSI trending up” means that the Relative Strength Index (RSI) values are increasing, indicating strengthening momentum in the stock's price. The RSI is a technical indicator commonly used by traders to assess price momentum and trend strength.

items.title: There is no contingency plan from government to deal with higher fuel price:  RS Sharma
items.description: My own assessment that prices will rise further from here on. Unfortunately there is no contingency plan from Govt on high crude prices, says RS Sharma, Former CMD, ONGC Group

items.title: Stock split alert! Last day to buy JSW Dulux shares to be eligible for 1:10 split
items.description: Accordingly, today is the last opportunity for investors to buy JSW Dulux’s shares to be eligible for the stock split.

items.title: Negative Breakout: These 8 large-cap stocks cross below their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the NSE large-cap pack, eight stocks' closing prices crossed below their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 19, according to technical scan data from StockEdge. Trading below the 200 DMA is generally considered a negative signal, as it suggests that a stock’s price is below its long-term trend. The 200 DMA is a widely used technical indicator that helps traders assess the overall trend of a stock.

items.title: Sun Pharma to raise Rs 10,000 crore to part-finance Organon deal
items.description: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries plans to raise ₹10,000 crore through two tranches of rupee-denominated bonds. The funds will help refinance bridge loans taken for the Organon acquisition valued at $11.75 billion. The first tranche will amount to ₹7,000 crore with a coupon rate of 8.20%. Institutional investors are expected to participate, including notable companies like SBI Pension Fund and ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund.

items.title: Stocks in news: Reliance Industries, Eternal, IREDA, Yes Bank, Trent and Hindustan Zinc
items.description: Indian equity benchmarks experienced a decline as profit-booking occurred amid rising crude oil prices. The Nifty 50 dropped significantly, closing at 22,889 after disappointing corporate earnings. Reliance Industries aims to raise funds through its initial public offering today, which is highly anticipated. Other companies such as IREDA and Yes Bank reported mixed financial results for the quarter. Investors are closely monitoring these developments and their potential market impacts.
